title: P15: exclude biases and LayerNorm parameters from pretraining decay
description: P15: split pretraining AdamW into matrix parameters with weight decay 0.1 and bias/LayerNorm scale and offset parameters with zero decay. Preserving learned normalization scales and offsets may produce a better starting policy for the fixed downstream expert-iteration procedure while retaining matrix regularization.
hypothesis: The incumbent decays every parameter. Run 013 increased decay tenfold and harmed all three downstream scores, while 009 removed all decay under the older single-seed protocol and did not improve; neither isolates decay-group membership. Avoiding shrinkage of LayerNorm scales and affine offsets may preserve proof features useful for RL adaptation without removing matrix regularization or capacity. The removed decay is modest at WD=0.1, so the effect may be negligible or may hurt generalization. Only downstream dev-transfer >=7 performance decides keep/discard.
expected_delta: Central prediction +3 to +12 dev-transfer theorems at true length >=7 versus incumbent 012 (exact mean 147.67; stored rounded mean 148), with plausible downside -25. Keep only if the seeds 0,1,2 mean improves. Splitting the same AdamW updates into two groups should have negligible direct latency impact (unmeasured); expect approximately 3000 steps in the unchanged 300-second pretraining budget. Model and per-token inference cost are unchanged; learned generation lengths may still change runtime under the fixed 1200-second total cap.

optimizer.name: adamw

decay_groups.parameters: all matrices, including token embeddings and output readout (ndim >= 2)
all biases and LayerNorm scale/offset parameters (ndim < 2)

optimizer.handoff: Pretraining optimizer discarded; frozen RL constructs its original AdamW optimizer without changes
